summary: The article provides a detailed and generally accurate preview of Intel's Q2 2026 earnings, aligning well with actual reported figures and management guidance. However, some of the consensus estimates presented in the article were slightly off compared to the actual results.

claims.claim: Intel is set to announce its Q2 2026 earnings after market close on July 23, 2026.
claims.note: Intel announced it would report Q2 2026 financial results on Thursday, July 23, 2026, after market close.

claims.claim: Consensus estimates project revenue around $14.42 billion and non-GAAP earnings per share (EPS) of $0.21-$0.22.
claims.note: Actual reported Q2 2026 revenue was $16.13 billion and non-GAAP EPS was $0.42, significantly higher than the consensus estimates cited in the article.

claims.claim: Management had guided for Q2 revenue between $13.8 billion and $14.8 billion, and non-GAAP EPS of $0.20.
claims.note: Intel's Q1 2026 earnings report included guidance for Q2 2026 revenue between $13.8 billion and $14.8 billion, and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $0.20.

claims.claim: In Q1 2026, Intel reported a robust non-GAAP EPS of $0.29 on revenue of $13.6 billion, both well ahead of analyst expectations.
claims.note: Intel reported Q1 2026 revenue of $13.6 billion and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $0.29.

claims.claim: In Q1 2026, Intel Foundry revenue grew 16% year-over-year to $5.4 billion.
claims.note: Intel Foundry revenue in Q1 2026 was $5.4 billion, up 16% year-over-year.

claims.claim: Management guided for Q2 non-GAAP gross margin to be approximately 39%, a modest decline from 41% reported in Q1 2026.
claims.note: Intel's Q1 2026 earnings report stated a non-GAAP gross margin of 41.0% for Q1 2026 and guided for a Q2 2026 non-GAAP gross margin of 39.0%.

claims.claim: CEO Lip-Bu Tan's commentary on the "sixth consecutive quarter of revenue above expectations" and the ongoing turnaround strategy will be closely scrutinised.
claims.note: Intel's CEO Lip-Bu Tan has indeed commented on the company delivering six consecutive quarters of revenue above expectations.

article_title: Intel (INTC) Stock Q2 2026 Earnings Preview: What to Expect
